question: Can you provide the top three races with the largest percentage differences between Google's 2021 overall hiring data from dar non intersectional hiring and the average percentages in the 2021 BLS data for the technology sectors specifically defined as 'Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals,' 'Software publishers,' 'Data processing, hosting, and related services,' or the industry group 'Computer systems design and related services,' along with their respective differences?
sql:
WITH google_hiring AS (
  SELECT 
    race_white AS g_white,
    race_black AS g_black,
    race_asian AS g_asian,
    race_hispanic_latinx AS g_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_dei.dar_non_intersectional_hiring`
  WHERE report_year = 2021 AND workforce = 'overall'
),
bls_tech AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(percent_white) AS b_white,
    AVG(percent_black_or_african_american) AS b_black,
    AVG(percent_asian) AS b_asian,
    AVG(percent_hispanic_or_latino) AS b_hispanic
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.bls.cpsaat18` 
  WHERE year = 2021 
    AND (
      subsector IN ('Internet publishing and broadcasting and web search portals', 'Software publishers', 'Data processing, hosting, and related services')
      OR industry_group = 'Computer systems design and related services'
    )
),
diffs AS (
  SELECT 
    'White' AS race,
    g.g_white AS google_pct,
    b.b_white AS bls_avg_pct,
    (g.g_white - b.b_white) AS diff_pct,
    ABS(g.g_white - b.b_white) AS abs_diff
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Black or African American', g.g_black, b.b_black, (g.g_black - b.b_black), ABS(g.g_black - b.b_black)
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Asian', g.g_asian, b.b_asian, (g.g_asian - b.b_asian), ABS(g.g_asian - b.b_asian)
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Hispanic or Latino', g.g_hispanic, b.b_hispanic, (g.g_hispanic - b.b_hispanic), ABS(g.g_hispanic - b.b_hispanic)
  FROM google_hiring g, bls_tech b
)
SELECT race, google_pct, bls_avg_pct, ROUND(diff_pct * 100, 2) AS diff_percentage
FROM diffs
ORDER BY abs_diff DESC
LIMIT 3
